ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota, particularly in the Somali community, and the involvement of government officials
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential government corruption
questions: What is the extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
What is the role of government officials in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and abuse of power in Minnesota. By following the money and investigating potential government corruption, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.

ideas.title: Trump's Hush-Money Trial
ideas.description: Investigate the hush-money payments made by Trump and the potential conflict of interest in the trial
ideas.angle: Investigate the integrity of the trial and potential bias
questions: What are the details of the hush-money payments?
Is there a conflict of interest in the trial?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose potential corruption and abuse of power in the Trump administration. By investigating the integrity of the trial and potential bias, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.
